claims.text: The hotel is a historic palazzo dating back to the 18th century.

findings.quote: is a historic palazzo dating back to the 18th century

claims.text: The hotel has been a member of The Leading Hotels of the World since 1990.

findings.quote: member of The Leading Hotels of the World since 1990

claims.text: The hotel is at Via dell'Indipendenza 8 in Bologna.
The hotel's historic wine cellar is known today as Enoteca Morandi, in homage to the Bolognese painter Giorgio Morandi.

findings.quote: The historic wine cellar of the Grand Hotel Majestic “già Baglioni”, it is known today as Enoteca Morandi, in homage to one of the most important Bolognese painters of the 20th century, Giorgio Morandi.

claims.text: The Enoteca Wine Bar hosts wine and food tastings with the hotel's sommelier.

findings.quote: The Enoteca Wine Bar, the historical and prestigious wine cellar of the Grand Hotel Majestic già Baglioni, is the ideal location for wine and food tastings with our sommelier.

claims.text: Classic and Superior rooms are furnished in traditional Venetian style.

findings.quote: Splendidly furnished in traditional Venetian style, the Classic and Superior rooms

claims.text: The Art Deco Terrace Suite is unique in the hotel in its style.

findings.quote: The Art Deco Terrace Suite, so named as it is unique in the hotel in terms of its style and originality

claims.text: The hotel has seven meeting rooms: three historic rooms in Venetian style with 16th-century decorations and chests, and four modern rooms; all have natural light.

findings.quote: the hotel now offers seven meeting rooms, of which three are historic — featuring the unmistakeable Venetian style and original decorations and chests from the 16th century — and four are modern. All rooms benefit from natural light

claims.text: The hotel offers cooking classes in handmade fresh pasta, guided by the hotel's chef.

findings.quote: our cooking classes dedicated to handmade fresh pasta. Under the expert guidance of our Chef

claims.text: The vaulted ceiling of the I Carracci restaurant is entirely frescoed by the school of the Carracci brothers.

findings.quote: The vaulted ceiling, entirely frescoed by the school of the Carracci brothers
The “I Carracci” restaurant is an authentic gem of art and history

claims.text: The Terrazza Torre and Terrazza Foyer are on the piano nobile, reserved for the suites; the Terrazza Torre overlooks Palazzo Fava.

findings.quote: Located on the piano nobile, reserved for the suites, the Terrazza Torre - overlooking Palazzo Fava - and the Terrazza Foyer offer an intimate and discreet atmosphere.

claims.text: The Café Marinetti floor was made by Tuscan artisans in Art Deco style using Statuario, Nero Marquinia and Giallo Siena marbles from Carrara.

findings.quote: The flooring, a genuine work of art, was made by Tuscan artisans in Art Deco style, using precious Statuario, Nero Marquinia and Giallo Siena marbles from Carrara.

claims.text: The Lost Perfume experience explores a historic fragrance born in 1827, beginning inside the hotel.

findings.quote: discover a historic fragrance born in 1827 and recently brought to light by its original formulas
the journey begins inside the Grand Hotel Majestic “già Baglioni”

claims.text: The terraces can be booked for drinks or light snacks, with a fee for the dedicated service.

findings.quote: The terraces can be booked for drinks or light snacks, with a fee for the dedicated service.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the city-center setting means limited on-site outdoor leisure space, such as a pool or large gardens.
WhataHotel notes rates reflect the hotel's five-star heritage positioning.
